source_commit_resolution: Git archive export-subst expands source_commit to the exact published commit; a normal checkout resolves it with git rev-parse in manifest.json and every readiness record.
launch_contract: One no-argument /bin/bash launch from any working directory

interpretation.engineering: PASS requires required_failures to be empty; induced failures remain FAIL evidence with separate detection rows
interpretation.lmz: run only when importable in the configured interpreter; otherwise retain per-arm NOT_RUN with reason
interpretation.affordability: INCONCLUSIVE without approved target BOM, power, thermal, cost and host/customer inputs
interpretation.specialized_deployment: INCONCLUSIVE without a named target workflow and customer evidence
interpretation.real_target: UNAVAILABLE; local fixtures, loopback services and bounded simulated links are proxy evidence
